title: A game master puts an effect on a wizard, which it and a wizard watching it see, and takes it off again
notes: Two wizards enter the Commons as in gm-commands-in-chat.json, and the companion turns to face the main wizard.
'effect add PostCombatEffect <wizard>' on the game server console gives the main wizard the effect the template
PostCombatEffect in Root.wad's GameEffectData makes, a NamedEffect that turns the wizard translucent; the game server sends
MSG_ADDEFFECT to the wizard's own client and to the companion's, and both are shot. 'effect remove 1 <wizard>' sends
MSG_REMOVEEFFECT with internal id 1 and both are shot again. The same is done with BearBallerinaTransformation, a
TransformationEffect that carries its template's m_sRace. Neither client may fail to load an effect it is sent or to find
its template. The server does not yet end an effect when its template's duration runs out, so each stays until it is
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
